chunks: "The Yemeni Corner is our gate through which we enter Paradise."

key_terms.الرُّكْنُ الْيَمَانِيُّ: the Yemeni Corner of the Ka'bah
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.بَابُنَا: our gate; a door specially associated with us

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the Yemeni Corner?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام describes the Yemeni Corner with a special connection to Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام and to entering Paradise. The hadith highlights the spiritual rank of this sacred place within the rites and virtues of hajj.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2160 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The Yemeni Corner is our gate through which we enter Paradise."
